title: SANADA leaves LIJ & wins the world title
summary: SANADA decides that a fresh start is necessary to escape his supporting role in Los Ingobernables. Joining Taichi’s group transforms his tournament run into a championship breakthrough.

chapters.title: SANADA leaves Naito behind
chapters.result: SANADA defeats Naito and joins Just Five Guys.
chapters.context: The tournament win becomes a public declaration of independence from LIJ.

chapters.title: The new start delivers the championship
chapters.result: SANADA defeats Okada for the world title.
chapters.context: Changing alliances and approach finally takes SANADA past the opponent who had repeatedly blocked his biggest ambitions.
